## Problem or need

Who benefits, and what reproducible problem are we solving?

## Proposal and alternatives

Describe a minimal change and other approaches considered.

## Scope and safety

- [ ] Uses synthetic data only, with no PHI or credentials
- [ ] Preserves research/workspace isolation and compatibility
- [ ] Does not make unqualified clinical, research, or model-readiness claims
- [ ] Does not remove third-party license notices or scientific provenance

## Acceptance criteria

What observable checks would show the proposal works?

## Related context

Link relevant discussions, issues, ADRs, documentation, or accepted research
questions where applicable. For major features, start in
[Discussions](https://github.com/AbdulazizShehri/MedOrigin/discussions).
